intro x
let ad_x := LieAlgebra.ad K L x
let engel_subalgebra := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
let engel_subalgebra_ideal := LieSubalgebra.isIdeal K x
have h_engel_ideal : LieIdeal K L engel_subalgebra := engel_subalgebra_ideal
let engel_submodule := Module.submodule_of_ideal K L h_engel_ideal
let engel_submodule_finrank := Module.finrank K engel_submodule
let charpoly_ad_x := LinearMap.charpoly (ad_x)
let natTrailingDegree_charpoly_ad_x := charpoly_ad_x.natTrailingDegree
let h_charpoly_ad_x := LinearMap.charpoly_natDegree K L ad_x (Module.Finite K L) (Module.Free K L) (Module.Finite K L) (StrongRankCondition.ofFiniteDimensional K L)
have h_natDegree_eq_finrank := h_charpoly_ad_x
let h_natTrailingDegree_eq_natDegree := Nat.trailingDegree_eq_natDegree (charpoly_ad_x.natDegree) (charpoly_ad_x.natTrailingDegree)
let h_natTrailingDegree_eq_finrank := h_natDegree_eq_finrank.trans h_natTrailingDegree_eq_natDegree
exact h_natTrailingDegree_eq_finrank
